_README: The 'arc of the war': named phases plus a dated timeline of discrete events. 'type' drives colour: escalation (red), deescalation (aqua), neutral (grey). Events are overlaid as markers on the Brent and US10Y charts. Append events as they happen and advance 'current_phase' index. Seed events replaced with sourced ones on 2026-11-08; each note names its source.

phases.name: Opening war
phases.blurb: 28 Feb – 7 Apr: US–Israeli strikes, Iranian missile waves on Israel and Gulf hosts, Hormuz effectively closed.

phases.name: Ceasefire & MoU
phases.blurb: 8 Apr – 7 Jul: Pakistan-brokered truce, 17 Jun MoU, partial reopening clears the stranded-tanker backlog.

phases.name: Maritime war
phases.blurb: 8 Jul – now: MoU collapses, US blockade reimposed, IRGC ship attacks hit a record in October, limited US strikes on the strait islands.

phases.name: Settlement
phases.blurb: Talks produce a text; attacks fall while transits climb under an agreed regime.

phases.name: Cessation
phases.blurb: Ship attacks near zero, transits normalised, blockade lifted.

timeline.title: War begins
timeline.note: Coordinated US–Israeli strikes on Iran; Iran retaliates across the Gulf and Hormuz traffic collapses. (Wikipedia: 2026 Iran war / Strait of Hormuz crisis)

timeline.title: Two-week ceasefire
timeline.note: Pakistan-mediated US–Iran ceasefire; it holds in some form until 8 Jul. (Wikipedia: 2026 Iran war ceasefire)

timeline.title: US blockade of Iranian ports
timeline.note: Runs 13 Apr – 29 May. (Wikipedia: Strait of Hormuz crisis)

timeline.title: US–Iran exchange fire under truce
timeline.note: US strikes Iranian sites after clashes in Hormuz. (CNN, NYT via Wikipedia)

timeline.title: Trump–Pezeshkian MoU
timeline.note: 60-day memorandum to end the war and reopen Hormuz. (JINSA)

timeline.title: MoU declared over
timeline.note: Iran strikes commercial ships; Trump calls the MoU 'over' and fire resumes. (JINSA; Wikipedia)

timeline.title: US blockade reimposed
timeline.note: CENTCOM resumes blockade of Iranian ports. (JINSA citing CENTCOM)

timeline.title: Houthis declare blockade on Saudi Arabia
timeline.note: Opens the Saudi front. (UKMTO weekly overview)

timeline.title: US strikes; Iran's biggest salvo since July
timeline.note: 70 Iranian missiles/drones on 31 Aug – 2 Sep at Jordan, Bahrain, Iraq, Kuwait. (JINSA 2 Sep)

timeline.title: Record week of ship attacks
timeline.note: 12 vessels hit 5–11 Oct, six on 11 Oct alone; October becomes the worst month of the war. (UKMTO via BBC Verify; Washington Institute)

timeline.title: Brent hits $115
timeline.note: First time since May. (JINSA 23 Oct)

timeline.title: First limpet-mine attack
timeline.note: Small boat attaches two charges to tanker Louise 1 off Khasab. (UKMTO via Reuters/Iran International)

timeline.title: US strikes Qeshm, Hengam, Bandar Abbas
timeline.note: Unannounced 'defensive' strikes on SAM sites; same day Iran floats a two-day Hormuz reopening. (AP via PBS/Washington Post; JINSA)

timeline.title: US midterms
timeline.note: Democrats take the House; Tehran reads it as a Republican defeat. (AP; Maritime Executive)

timeline.title: IRGC claims four tankers mined, two ships seized
timeline.note: Claimed mine strikes south of the strait plus two seizures; unverified. (JINSA 4 Nov)

timeline.title: US hits Qeshm air defences again
timeline.note: Trump confirms 'minor strikes'; Iran weighs Qatari proposals. (AP via Washington Post; RFE/RL)

timeline.title: IRGC lifts 2,000 km missile-range cap
timeline.note: Announced by IRGC spokesman Mohebbi. (RFE/RL citing Iranian media)

timeline.title: US disables blockade-runner M/V Huda
timeline.note: St Kitts-flagged tanker disabled after leaving an Iranian port. (ISW/CTP Iran Update, 8 Nov)

timeline.title: Houthi missiles at Riyadh
timeline.note: Intercepted; falling debris damages the Aramco tower. Tanker struck outbound in Hormuz the night before. (Saudi Energy Ministry via ABC News / Iran International; UKMTO)

timeline.title: Trump: new strikes 'highly unlikely'; Rubio: no breakthrough
timeline.note: Trump tells CNN strikes are unlikely while talks progress; Rubio calls Iran's terms unrealistic before the G7 in Paris. (ISW/CTP; Fox News citing Reuters)

timeline.title: IRGC says southern-lane navigation aids destroyed
timeline.note: IRGC Navy official tells state media no unauthorised vessels transited overnight. (Reuters via Arab News)

timeline.title: Qatar PM brings Iran's interim Hormuz terms to Trump
timeline.note: White House meeting; reported terms (Israel Hayom, unconfirmed): reopen Hormuz and halt tanker attacks for lifting the blockade and releasing $8bn. Brent Jan falls ~6% to the low $92s. (Fox News; OK Energy Today)
